author: Chillblaze
quote: i'm lost for words this cant be **** drops to 15, no freedom, glitches, falling thru the ground once every hour, glitching thru objects, flying thru buildings, falling from the sky without losing hp, took me hours just to push this terrible storyline till i can get some action but it felt dull... they ruined my favourite game and denied refund! this is not gta anymore ! we need to reverse engineer the engine, start gofundme and recreate GTA6 from scratch with proper story and player freedom! if we unite we can fix the pc version !
